Cradle of the Stars (Korean: 별들의 요람, byeoldeur-ui yoram) is Eggsquisite Brooch's second Costume, released in the first half of the Holiday Training Academy Exam update. It is an Epic Costume that can only be obtained by purchasing it in the GCL Limited Costume Shop!.

Story

Eggsquisite Brooch knows the stories of countless stars born and disappearing in the dark night sky. With pristine feathers adorned with golden embellishments, the Pet peacefully slumbers. What dreams could be unfolding in its silent slumber?

Trivia

  • Cradle of the Stars was released alongside  Embracer of the Night.

Call of the Black Swan (Korean: 흑조의 노래, heukjoui norae, "Song of the Black Swan") is Eggsquisite Brooch's first Costume, released in the first half of The Witch's Mystic Attic update. It is an Epic Costume that can only be obtained through a Pet Costume package in the Package Shop.

Story

Eggsquisite Brooch wrapped itself in silky, black feathers. While as elegant as a ballet performance, this Pet silently waits... but for what? Could the legends, speaking of the Black Swan singing just before it awakens, be true?

Trivia

  • Call of the Black Swan is the second Costume to reference to the Black Swan, with the first being  Black Swan.
